questions.text:
Multiple choice questions -
1. There is usually an Apparent change in weight during a - (a) Physical change (b) Chemical change (c) Reversible change (d) None of these
2. Alcohol in water is an example of- (a) Homogeneous mixture (b) Heterogeneous mixture (c) Both (a) and (b) (d) none of these
3. Why do isotopes have same electronic configurations ? (a) They have same number of electrons (b) They have same number of neutrons (c) They have same number of protons (d) They have same mass number
4. Which noble gas has two electrons in its valence shell (a) Helium (b) Neon (c) Argon (d) Xenon
5. Which one is monovalent – (a) Magnesium (b) Sodium (c) Calcium (d) Iron
6. Element with variable valencies – (a) Mg (b) Al (c) Fe (d) Zn
7. The Radioactive isotopes used in the cure of thyroid cancer is – (a) P-32 (b) Ca-60 (c) Na-23 (d) i-131
8. The decomposition of sodium bicarbonate on heating is – (a) A catalysed reaction (b) An endothermic reaction (c) An exothermic reaction (d) None of these
9. Mechanical separation is used to separate the constituents of – (a) Molecule (b) Element (c) Compound (d) Mixture
10. Which is not a compound – (a) Water (b) carbon (c) carbon dioxide (d) Nitrogen dioxide
Diagram based questions –
11. Which element has the electronic configuration shown in the figure 1 ? (a) Hydrogen (b) Helium (c) Carbon (d) Oxygen
12. Name the atomic model proposed by Scientist J.J. Thompson shown in the (figure 2). (a) Pineapple pudding (b) Apple pie pudding model (c) Thomson electron model (d) None of these

questions.text:
Assertion – Reason type questions.
In the questions given below, there are two statements marked as Assertion [A] and Reason [R]. Read the statements and choose the correct option.
(a) If both Assertion [A] and Reason [R] are correct and Reason [R] is the correct explanation of Assertion [A].
(b) If both Assertion [A] and Reason [R] are correct but Reason [R] is not the correct explanation of Assertion [A].
(c) If Assertion [A] is true but Reason [R] is false.
(d) If Assertion [A] is false but Reason [R] is true.
13. Assertion [A] : We can use decantation to remove sand particles from water. Reason [B] : Sand shows magnetic Properties.
14. Assertion [A] : Electrons in the outermost shell experience very small nuclear force. Reason [B] : The distance between electron and nucleus is Greater.
15. Assertion [A] : Flood is a non periodic change. Reason [B] : Non periodic changes do not occur at regular intervals.
